mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorites (isbn, title, description, publisher, thumbnail, url, created_at) VALUES (#{isbn}, #{title}, #{description}, #{publisher}, #{thumbnail}, #{url}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO favorite_authors (favorite_id, author_order, author) VALUES
(#{id}, #{position}, #{author})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM favorites WHERE isbn = #{isbn})

SELECT f.id, f.isbn, f.title, f.description, f.publisher, f.thumbnail, f.url, f.created_at, a.author_order, a.author FROM favorites f LEFT JOIN favorite_authors a ON a.favorite_id = f.id WHERE f.id = #{id} ORDER BY a.author_order

SELECT f.id, f.isbn, f.title, f.description, f.publisher, f.thumbnail, f.url, f.created_at, a.author_order, a.author FROM ( SELECT id, isbn, title, description, publisher, thumbnail, url, created_at FROM favorites ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) f LEFT JOIN favorite_authors a ON a.favorite_id = f.id ORDER BY f.id DESC, a.author_order
SELECT id FROM favorites WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
